traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage on saves vs. spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Death Knight)
traits.text: CHA save DC 16. At will: Detect Magic, Command, Hold Person. 3/day each: Animate Dead, Cone of Cold. 1/day each: Dominate Monster, Wall of Ice.

traits.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
traits.text: If reduced to 0 HP: returns in 1d4 days, gaining HP equal to half its max + 1d10 per day waited. Cannot be destroyed permanently unless bless spell cast at 9th level over corpse.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Two longsword attacks or one with spell.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.text: +9 to hit. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 4) slashing or 12 (2d10 + 4) two-handed, or 11 (2d8 + 4) slashing + 5 (1d10) necrotic on two-handed.

actions.name: Hellfire Orb
actions.text: 1/day; ranged spell attack +9, range 150 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 4) fire + 14 (4d6) necrotic. DC 16 CON or half damage.

legendaryActions.name: Rallying Blow
legendaryActions.text: Bonus: One ally within 30 ft gains advantage on attacks until end of next turn; 1 use per ally per combat.

legendaryActions.name: Reaping Strike (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: One greatsword attack; on hit, target must save STR vs DC 16 or fall prone and lose 10 ft of movement.
